name: FlowScriptAPI
title: FlowScriptAPI - Scoped
summary: The FlowScriptAPI API provides a method to return the context ID of the running flow.
overview: You cannot instantiate objects of this type. Objects of this type are created automatically and are accessible only in script steps and inline scripts.

members.name: getContextID
members.summary: Returns the context ID of the running flow.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
String The sys_id of the running flow.

This example assumes you have created a flow containing a Log action. This inline script generates the content of the Log message.

var contextId = FlowScriptAPI.getContextID();
return contextId;
Output:
4ecead85c4da0010598d0c7c6bf73554
